description.text: Program Description Photogrammetry and remote sensing is an art, science and technology, through the use of unmanned imaging and other sensor systems to record and measure, and then analyze the data and presentation, to get on the earth and its environment, and other natural objects and processes of reliable information. Duration 3 years

duration.text: The Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing at Beihang University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4861 USD/per year ￥ 35000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 7. Financial support statement A certificate from the financial guarantor of the applican

requirements.text: 1.The Applicant should be expected to study hard, observe the laws and decrees of the Chinese government and abide by the regulations of BUAA. 2.In general the applicant should have a Bachelor of Science (B.S.) degree or have the equivalent educational background of (a B.S.) degree. 3.The applicant should be forty years of age or under. 4.The applicant must have a good command of English and have the ability to take courses in English
